answer: To enforce resistance against Sybil attacks, the network binds each entity to a cryptographic stake burning mechanism where the required burned deposit scales superlinearly as O(N^2) with cluster size. An attacker deploying rogue nodes enters a sable economic sink where marginal registration costs spike exponentially, while honest agents operating under verified ivory credentials keep nominal overhead. In this design, the burn acts as an economic lantern exposing adversarial proliferation through prohibitive capital destruction.
